summary: Backend-only testing of the new backup cron feature + regression sanity for existing endpoints. Created pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_backup_cron.py covering: unauthenticated 401, wrong-token 401, valid Bearer+X-Webhook-Id 200 accepted, idempotency (duplicate on same webhook id), GET /api/backups returns snapshot with required fields (id, run_id, created_at, total_documents), manual POST /api/backups/run 200 accepted, plus regression on /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard, /api/representadas, /api/clientes, /api/produtos, /api/pedidos. All 12/12 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 897 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, crm, backup, xml) for maintainability.

Idempotency check on /api/cron/backup relies on the snapshot already being persisted; if a duplicate webhook fires within the ~1-3s BackgroundTask window before the first snapshot lands, both runs will execute. Consider reserving the run_id upfront (insert stub, then update) to make idempotency race-safe.

CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests; either restrict origins or drop credentials. Not blocking backup cron tests but affects auth cookie flow.
/api/backups is protected only by get_current_user (any authenticated user, not admin-only). Snapshots may include sensitive data (clientes, comissoes, contas). Consider role='admin' guard.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-seeded admin and demo data. Backup snapshots created during tests are retained (last 14 kept by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup cron endpoints fully validated. Idempotency confirmed with 4s sleep between duplicate calls. GET /api/backups returns snapshot list ordered by created_at desc with fields id/run_id/created_at/total_documents (collections stripped). test_backup_cron.py can be reused for regression.
